event_summary: A small blue round object moves from left to right across a tabletop, passes beyond the tabletop edge, and exits the frame on the right.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a stationary view of a tan wood-grain tabletop beside a light wall and a light rectangular sheet or panel on the right. After a period with no moving object visible, a small blue round object enters from the left on the tabletop. It travels rightward across the tabletop with visible blur, reaches the tabletop's right edge, then appears to the right of that edge in front of the light wall or sheet area. It continues rightward with a slightly lower image position and leaves the frame at the right side. The scene remains otherwise unchanged.

reasons: The tabletop, wall, and right-side sheet or panel are visible before the blue object appears.
The moving blue object is not visible in the first frame.
